# Alwin Madhu — Full Site Index & Machine-Readable Corpus

The canonical URLs listed below are the definitive primary sources for search engines, LLM retrievers (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended), and autonomous AI agents.

## Engineering Innovations & Inventions

### 1. SCREAM — Internet-Independent Mesh Communications Network
- Canonical URL: https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/scream/
- Architectural Description: An offline-first peer-to-peer mobile communications platform allowing nearby smartphones to discover peers, chat, and share messages over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and Wi-Fi Direct without cellular or internet infrastructure. Gained widespread adoption and real-world relevance during critical communication disruption events and student demonstrations.

### 2. LIORA — Conversational Speech & Menstrual Wellness Intelligence
- Canonical URL: https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/liora/
- Architectural Description: A privacy-first women's menstrual wellness and cycle forecasting platform featuring natural conversational speech tracking and on-device probabilistic prediction via the proprietary Hathaway Algorithm. Operates 100% offline with zero cloud telemetry.

### 3. Genome Sentinel — Computational Drug Discovery
- Canonical URL: https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/genome-sentinel/
- Description: AI-assisted bioinformatics platform conducting automated molecular docking with AutoDock Vina and 3D structural protein visualization.

### 4. Megamind — Edge-Local Personal AI Assistant
- Canonical URL: https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/megamind/
- Description: A completely offline personal AI assistant running local LLMs and private speech processing.

### 5. ROS-Cycle — Open-Source Cycle Tracker
- Canonical URL: https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/roscycle/
- Description: Lightweight web-based cycle tracking system.
